description: One session on a Colab A100-SXM4-40GB: Qwen3-4B, thinking on. Items run one after the other, each in its own process. 1) Baseline on the 20 held-out evaluation words: vLLM gets 65% of the GPU (26 GB: 8 GB weights, ~16 GB KV cache, ~110k tokens); the trainer's own model copy takes 8 GB. 2) Low-rank LoRA GRPO for 50 steps (one pass over the 100 training words): each step generates 16 games (2 words x 8) with vLLM at 50% of the GPU (20 GB, ~10 GB KV, ~70k tokens, ~7 full-length 9.2k-token games at once), then trains on them one game at a time (batch 1 x 16 accumulation) in the remaining ~20 GB. Evaluations on the same 20 words at steps 25 and 50; checkpoints every 15 steps. Sampling: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20.
